coverage.sidecar_justification: Sidecar holds only secondary nested contractor/vendor company-profile attributes (address, phone, logo, website, labor_union, project_ids[], profile attachments). High-value contract financials and vendor/contractor identity are first-class columns; these profile attributes are polymorphic company-directory metadata with no contract-analytics value.

Sidecar is dominated by per-tenant dynamic custom-field DEFINITION metadata (custom_field_<id>.data_type) and origin_data blobs. Custom-field ids are project-specific and polymorphic, so their definition metadata cannot be fixed columns. Standard PO business and financial fields are first-class columns.
